text:
I still remember

that street

of yellow lamps,

with that full

moon among the electric

wires


And that star

on the corner,

a distant radio,

the tower of La Merced

that struck those

eleven:


And the golden light

of your open

door, on that street.

translation.title: I Still Remember
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the remembered street as a sequence of lamps, wires, bells, and the beloved's doorway.
